title: Help page: does the rewrite actually read more easily?
question: Two versions of the help overlay (/). One is what ships today, one is a rewrite. Which one can you find a key in faster? Note the shipping one is clipped: it runs three lines past its own panel, so 'K A/B EXPERIMENT', 'F5 RELOAD ASSETS' and the line naming the key that CLOSES it are drawn off-screen. It also lists two keys it cannot draw - ';' (depth light) and ''' (glow shape) render as blank gaps, because the 5x7 font has no glyph for either. Both fixed in the rewrite along with the two new water-merge keys.
